description: Defines classes and structures for a FIFO buffer implementation in Android, including buffer management, subclasses for internal/external storage, and related methods.

classes.name: FifoBuffer
classes.description: Abstract base class for FIFO buffer management, providing core buffer operations and proxy methods for internal controller.

classes.name: FifoBufferAllocated
classes.description: Subclass of FifoBuffer that allocates storage internally.

classes.name: FifoBufferIndirect
classes.description: Subclass of FifoBuffer that uses externally provided storage.

classes.name: WrappingBuffer
classes.description: Structure representing a potentially split region in a circular buffer.

methods.name: FifoBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing FIFO buffer with bytes per frame.

methods.name: convertFramesToBytes
methods.description: Converts frame count to byte count.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads frames from the buffer into destination.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes frames to the buffer from source.

methods.name: getThreshold
methods.description: Returns the threshold value.

methods.name: setThreshold
methods.description: Sets the threshold value.

methods.name: getBufferCapacityInFrames
methods.description: Returns buffer capacity in frames.

methods.name: getFullDataAvailable
methods.description: Provides pointer to full data and split info.

methods.name: getEmptyRoomAvailable
methods.description: Provides pointer to empty space and split info.

methods.name: getBytesPerFrame
methods.description: Returns bytes per frame.

methods.name: getReadCounter
methods.description: Proxy to internal controller's read counter.

methods.name: setReadCounter
methods.description: Proxy to set internal controller's read counter.

methods.name: getWriteCounter
methods.description: Proxy to internal controller's write counter.

methods.name: setWriteCounter
methods.description: Proxy to set internal controller's write counter.

methods.name: advanceReadIndex
methods.description: Proxy to advance read index.

methods.name: advanceWriteIndex
methods.description: Proxy to advance write index.

methods.name: getEmptyFramesAvailable
methods.description: Proxy to get available empty frames.

methods.name: getFullFramesAvailable
methods.description: Proxy to get available full frames.

methods.name: eraseMemory
methods.description: Clears buffer memory.

methods.name: FifoBufferAllocated
methods.description: Handles internal storage allocation for FIFO buffer.

methods.name: FifoBufferIndirect
methods.description: Handles external storage for FIFO buffer.
